proposals.title: Simple Majority Vote
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to replace each supermajority voting requirement in charter and bylaws with a majority of votes cast for and against, or a simple majority.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Political Spending
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of Eliana Fishman, with co-filers Leslie Oelsner Bene IRA of S Berman and PCR Children's Tr FBO Ellen Remmer
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report analyzing whether political, lobbying and electioneering expenditures are congruent with AbbVie's publicly stated values and policies.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Lobbying
proposals.proponent: Dana Investment Advisers, with co-filer Dominican Sisters of Springfield Illinois
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing lobbying policies, payments including trade association and social welfare group payments, and board oversight.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Patent Process
proposals.proponent: Friends Fiduciary Corporation, with numerous co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to establish and report on a process considering the impact of extended patent exclusivities on product access when pursuing secondary and tertiary patents.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
